caption.zh: 写作引擎界面示意：设定按需调用，分支互不干扰。
caption.en: Writing engine interface: retrieves story details as needed and keeps branches separate.

mem1d.zh: 林岚：前刑警，左手有旧伤，说话简短。
mem1d.en: Lin Lan: ex-detective, old injury on her left hand, speaks in short sentences.

mem2d.zh: 海港城：雨季漫长，老城区与新港区靠轮渡相连。
mem2d.en: Harbour city: long rainy seasons; the old town and new port are linked by ferry.

mem3d.zh: 林岚在码头收到第二封匿名信。
mem3d.en: Lin Lan receives a second anonymous letter at the docks.
